conclusion: Jitter, with a wider band than the Phase 2 move suggested. p95 across the four runs spans 77.47 to 176.09 ms. The two fresh runs agree on the tail (p95 176.09 vs 173.20) while p50 moved 68.31 to 98.10 between them minutes apart, and the raw model got faster (p50 51.08 vs 61.97) while the API got slower, so the numbers are set by shared-CPU load on this VM, not by the code: nothing in the request path changed since Phase 2 and the artifact is identical. Quote ranges, not a single number, and re-measure on the deployment machine.
